body.p: In Tolariak, north of Padli, the people were hunting caribou, and catching salmon in a lake. A boy who was fishing with a sealing-harpoon had become fast to a salmon. He had wound a bight of the harpoon-line round his wrist. The salmon was so large that it dragged him into the water and drowned him. The whole fall and winter the people had a great many salmon and caribou, and they had to travel a great many times with their sledges to their summer hunting-ground to bring the provisions home.
